build_transform_image_edit_request: build an OpenAI-style image edit request to Black Forest Labs format with base64-encoded images and optional parameters
transform_image_edit_response: transform a Black Forest Labs async response into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse with the final image URL
validate_environment: validate the Black Forest Labs API key and return configured headers with x-key authentication
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image edit parameters to Black Forest Labs parameters with BFL-specific passthrough and defaults
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by Black Forest Labs image edit models
